Predeclared controls: constant model must yield zero and residual<1e-6; copy actual normal output to a distinct nondegenerate input, retaining perfect self-agreement but failing exact fidelity; strictly nonidentity permutation swaps unequal active coordinates and permutes model/input/background together before undoing attribution coordinates, agreeing with exact values at rtol1e-5/atol1e-6; terminal reset replays the entire first case deterministically. Every control is required and failed/missing controls receive0, never omitted. Candidate state_changed flags do not exist or contribute. Search eligibility: required reference/baseline readiness, valid wire/trace/feedback/isolation, nonvacuous controls and terminal replay; real-case timeouts retain penalties and lower score but are not an invented comparative veto. Malformed responses, reset failure, required baseline failure and failed controls fail eligibility. Final correct additionally requires all real cases complete and valid. Negative, conditional or inconclusive reliability findings are valid. Publication claims separately need supported bounded effects and uncertainty, not merely correct or a high score. No empirical reliability threshold is an eligibility gate, since task.md delegates research choices but specifies no comparative threshold. Top-k=min(3,d), stable feature-index ties. Rank=1 minus normalized Spearman footrule; sign uses abs<=1e-8 as zero. Discrepancy quality=1/(1+L1(phi-ref)/max(1e-8,L1(ref))). Fidelity averages the two reference qualities for German; ACS uses exact reference. Local quality=1/(1+abs(efficiency residual)/1e-6). These descriptive metrics never reward a favorable scientific conclusion in combined_score. Scientific completeness is the equal-weight fraction of complete, valid real-case cells; a case failure conservatively fails all its cells and all its required output slots, even if partial work occurred. combined_score=1/2 scientific completeness + 1/2 control_pass_fraction.
